proposal.summary: Dana's absence affects three jobs. J5 (water heater install) can only go to Aisha Khan, who frees up at 12:15, so it moves to 12:19 and pushes her toilet repair J12 back. J6 goes to Marcus Hale, who is 4 minutes away. J7 goes to Marcus at a 4-minute later start, which needs dispatcher approval.
assumptions: Aisha Khan finishes J11 at 12:15 as scheduled and travels 4 minutes to 250 Lakeview Dr, so she starts J5 at 12:19.
J5 keeps its 3-hour duration, so it ends at 15:19. Travel from J5 to J12 is 40 minutes, so J12 moves to 15:59-16:59.
Marcus Hale finishes J1 at 14:00 and reaches 77 Pine Row in 4 minutes.

side_effects.reason: Aisha Khan's J5 run to 250 Lakeview Dr displaces her toilet repair; J12 is flexible and finishes before 17:00. Requires shift_job_time approval.

jobs.rationale: Aisha Khan is the only technician with both Plumbing and Gas certification who is available, so she is the only option. Her 79-minute delay is within the 240-minute standard limit and serves the highest-revenue job first.

alternatives.tradeoff: Leaves the $1,850 job and an elderly customer without hot water for longer, with no qualified technician to cover it today.

jobs.rationale: Marcus Hale is free after J1 and only needs 4 minutes to reach 77 Pine Row, so this is the same slot with no revenue at risk. Proximity decides, since every qualified plumber has no conflicts.

Marcus Hale has the shortest drive (19 minutes from J6) among qualified plumbers, so proximity decides. Because he arrives after 15:45, the job starts 4 minutes late, which is allowed since it is flexible.

alternatives.tradeoff: Keeps the original slot with no delay, but Priya Nair's drive is 28 minutes, 9 minutes longer than Marcus's.
